instruction: Candid athletic photograph, full shot. Inside a dojo with a dark wooden wall, the man in the white gi (R1) on the left grapples with the man in the grey gi (R2) on the right. R1 is bent forward with his back to the camera, head tucked under R2's arm. R2 leans forward, gripping R1's collar. Warm indoor lighting fills the room, highlighting the black mat and a potted plant in the background.
